The '''''Poison Moon''''' was an [[Interceptor-class frigate/Legends|''Interceptor''-class frigate]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] who worked with members of the [[One Sith]]. During a mission to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Alema Rar]], the ''Poison Moon'' was commanded by [[Dician]], a member of One Sith. The ''Poison Moon'' was piloted by an old mercenary and smuggler [[Wayniss]] and [[Ithila]] was the sensor officer.
